items.title: Who is this consultation for?
items.description: Business owners, entrepreneurs, manufacturers, and professionals exploring questions about business setup, expansion, partnerships, or commercial Vastu.

items.title: What details will I need to share?
items.description: Depending on the consultation, you may be asked for your date, time and place of birth, company details, your main business question, and a property layout for Vastu. The initial form only collects contact details.

items.title: Can I consult online?
items.description: You can request an online consultation through the enquiry form. The consultant will confirm the format, availability, and fee with you directly.

items.title: Are business results guaranteed?
items.description: No. Astrology and Vastu are traditional interpretive practices. They do not guarantee business outcomes and should be considered alongside practical business, financial, and professional advice.

items.title: How is my consultation confirmed?
items.description: Submit an enquiry and the consultant will contact you to discuss scope, pricing, and availability. Submitting the form does not confirm an appointment or take a payment.
